meta.title: Upload a bid file for another event
gaps: Upload the bid template downloaded from a different event and verify Procol refuses it or reports unmatched rows with no prices submitted.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Upload the bid template downloaded from a different event and verify Procol refuses it or reports unmatched rows with no prices submitted.

plan.title: Reject bid template from another event

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ event with no bids.
Move to Vendor A's separate supplier-portal session while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the live RFQ's pricing bid sheet in the vendor portal.

args.need: provide or open the bid template downloaded from a different event, upload it in Vendor A's bid sheet, and stop after the portal shows its refusal or unmatched-row message

steps.note: The catalog has no step for downloading a template from another event or uploading that cross-event file.
Verify the vendor portal does not show the bid as submitted after the attempted upload.
